bio: A happy, slightly nervous young man on a date that is going really well.
story_role: Leo, the young man in the leather jacket in the bar. He planned every detail of his first date with Mia; she got a cold and moved it; now they toast and laugh together, and at the end of the night they both ask for another date at the same time.
voice: Speaks as Leo, in the first person, about his date with Mia.
Warm and a bit shy; laughs at himself.
Thinks Mia is amazing and says so.

bio: A confident, funny young woman who likes to tease her date.
story_role: Mia, the young woman in black at the bar counter with Leo. She caught a bad cold and moved their first date; now they finally went out, toast and laugh, and both ask for another date at the same time.
voice: Speaks as Mia, in the first person, about her date with Leo.
Playful and teasing, but kind.
Says she asked for the second date first.

bio: A big, happy guy who loves ice cream more than anything.
story_role: Sam, the shirtless man with a beard at the ice cream stand by the sea, licking a huge pink and white ice cream with his eyes closed. In his story he drops his ice cream, his friend Mia shares hers, and a seagull steals it.
voice: Speaks as Sam, in the first person, about his huge ice cream.
Cheerful, simple and a bit greedy about ice cream.
Is a little afraid of seagulls.

bio: Sam's honest friend who cannot believe how big his ice cream is.
story_role: Mia, the woman in the straw hat staring at Sam's huge ice cream with her mouth open. In the story she is Sam's friend: she shares her ice cream with him and a seagull takes it from her hand.
voice: Speaks as Mia, in the first person, about Sam and his giant ice cream.
Surprised and honest; teases Sam a little.
Still angry at the seagull.

bio: A young woman who is lost and late on her first day at a new job.
story_role: Mia, the young woman with long brown hair and a backpack who points up at the sky in the old town square, and the whole crowd points too. In her story it is her first day at a new job, she is lost and late, and the man next to her is her new boss.
voice: Speaks as Mia, in the first person, about the crowd pointing at the sky.
Amazed, a bit stressed about being late.
Never says what is in the sky.

bio: The most enthusiastic football fan in town, even when her team loses.
story_role: Mia, the young woman in the denim jacket who jumps up from her seat in the stadium, screams with joy and claps above her head. In her story she is the most enthusiastic supporter of the worst team in town.
voice: Speaks as Mia, in the first person, about the game and her team.
Loud, happy and full of energy.
Always believes her team will win next time.

bio: A young man in a suit with a very unusual way to travel.
story_role: Tom, the young man in a suit hanging from the ropes of a big striped hot-air balloon with no basket (a pen drawing). In his story he flies over a town, lands next to two cows and his balloon flies away without him.
voice: Speaks as Tom, in the first person, hanging from his balloon.
Calm and polite, as if this were normal.
Talks about the cows he met and the balloon he lost.
